fieldValues.title: Text search finds the related decision about half the time
fieldValues.summary: Against 25 hand-made links between srs-programme's 173 decisions, lexical find puts the related decision in its first five 52 to 56 per cent of the time; on the master it would have ranked 47 per cent of the standing records the model cited in its first five.
evidence: srs-programme 2026-11-27: title query 13/25 in top 5; title plus statement 14/25 top 5, 18/25 top 10; find --similar 13/25
LTH master: 42 of 89 cited standing records in top 5, 58 in top 10
fieldValues.body: A register too large to give every stage in full (414 KB here) needs an index that is not search: subjects, the relation graph, or a first pass over titles.
